name: cicy-knowledge
title: Cicy Knowledge
description: Team knowledge store CLI over cicy-code /api/knowledge: add/list/get/recall/promote/reject/supersede + draft/deprecate maturity flags + specialist pin. Recall = keyword+tag over canon, no vector RAG.
author: cicy-ai

tools.name: knowledge add
tools.description: Add a new pending knowledge entry (markdown body via --body/--body-file/stdin). Returns its id.

tools.name: knowledge list
tools.description: List knowledge filtered by status / tag / keyword.

tools.name: knowledge recall
tools.description: Keyword/tag recall over CANON entries only (exact-ish match over title+tags+body; no vector RAG).

tools.name: knowledge govern
tools.description: Governance transitions used by the 知识专员: promote→canon, reject, or supersede an entry with a newer one.

tools.name: knowledge maturity
tools.description: Maturity flags separate from location: add --draft lands in _drafts/ (未成稿); draft/deprecate mark an existing entry in place so it drops out of canon recall; restore clears the flag.

tools.name: knowledge specialist
tools.description: Show or pin which pane is the 知识专员 (receives memory-hook briefs). Config-file backed (global.json), not a DB role query; defaults to the master pane w-1001.
